item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Westlife - My Love (Apple Music 4K)
item.description:
Hi, today Westlife has upload an upgraded version in 4K for music video 'My Love'. It is a proper scan and remaster from original film reels. Actually there is a little problem by color grading but the quality is still very good. Can someone download and share the 4K version from Apple Music. This is the newest video in their catalogue in Apple Music. I muss to say that because they still keep the SD version there. I can see this because i have account but i do not have a tool to download.
Thank you so much!
